ota.summary: New: an Alarm stored on the node (Alarm + Alarm time) that rings from the node's own clock even if Home Assistant is down, and a 'Battery' setting (Fitted / No battery fitted) so a USB-only node stops showing a fake 100 %. Plus beta3-4: Last crash, Power status, honest battery %, plug/unplug halo cue, safer empty-battery shutdown, Room comfort, battery saver, pinhole reset.
